lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a repeating grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of lighter intensity cross the horizontal spot rows, with spots primarily positioned at these intersections to create a structured matrix.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct shadow-driven gradient transition.

other_distinctive_markers: Two remoras (Echeneidae) are attached to the mid and lower regions of the lateral flank.
